Video Editing AI Software Free — v1.0.0

- Initial release: AI-powered cloud video editing with instant MP4 export.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; automated trimming, transitions, and audio/text overlays.
- Anonymous sign-up with 100 free credits and session-based cloud rendering.
- Simple chat-based workflow: upload raw clips, describe edits, receive finished video in 1–2 minutes.
- Full error handling for token, session, credits, and file size issues; user-friendly progress updates.
- Easy export & download, 1080p rendering, batch and iterative editing supported.
